sql_a: SELECT SUM(t2.c0) AS c0, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.c1) AS c1, SUM(t2.c2) AS c2, SUM(t2.c3) AS c3, SUM(t2.c4) AS c4, COUNT(t2.c5) AS c5, SUM(t2.c6) AS c6, SUM(t2.c7) AS c7, SUM(t2.c8) AS c8, SUM(t2.c9) AS c9, COUNT(t2.c10) AS c10 FROM (SELECT t1.c5 AS c0, (CASE WHEN (t1.c2 = 'CLERK') THEN t1.c7 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) END) AS c1, (CASE WHEN (t1.c7 = 10) THEN t1.c5 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) END) AS c2, (CASE WHEN (t1.c7 = 20) THEN t1.c5 ELSE 0 END) AS c3, (CASE WHEN (t1.c7 = 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c4, (CASE WHEN (t1.c7 = 40) THEN 'x' ELSE CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) END) AS c5, (CASE WHEN (t1.c7 = 45) THEN 1 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) END) AS c6, (CASE WHEN (t1.c7 = 50) THEN 1 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) END) AS c7, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19, 9)) AS c8, (CASE WHEN (t1.c7 = 70) THEN CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) ELSE 1 END) AS c9, (CASE WHEN (t1.c7 = 20) THEN 1 ELSE CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) END) AS c10 FROM (SELECT EMPNO AS c0, ENAME AS c1, JOB AS c2, MGR AS c3, HIREDATE AS c4, SAL AS c5, COMM AS c6, DEPTNO AS c7, SLACKER AS c8 FROM EMP) AS t1) AS t2

sql_calcite:
select
 sum(sal) as sum_sal,
 count(distinct case

 sum(case when deptno = 10 then sal end) as sum_sal_d10,
 sum(case when deptno = 20 then sal else 0 end) as sum_sal_d20,
 sum(case when deptno = 30 then 1 else 0 end) as count_d30,

 sum(case when deptno = 45 then 1 end) as count_d45,
 sum(case when deptno = 50 then 1 else null end) as count_d50,
 sum(case when deptno = 60 then null end) as sum_null_d60,

select coalesce(sum_match, 0) as sum0_match, sum_distinct_not_match,
 count_distinct_match, count_star_match from (
 select
 sum(sal) filter(where deptno = 10) as sum_match,
 sum(distinct empno) filter(where deptno = 20) as sum_distinct_not_match,

 )
